issues.description: The problem statement and the template expect a public Farm method named singFarmSong(), but the solution implementation defines this functionality in a method named playFarmSong(). This naming mismatch (singFarmSong vs. playFarmSong) can confuse students and prevent straightforward mapping between the specification/template and the provided solution (and may cause tests or example code that call singFarmSong() to fail).
issues.suggestedFix: Align the identifier across artifacts. Rename the solution method playFarmSong() to singFarmSong(), or add a public singFarmSong() wrapper that delegates to playFarmSong(). Also update any example calls (e.g., in Main) to use the consistent method name so that the solution, template, and problem statement match.
